channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: A World of Keflings
item.description: Keflings may be small, but their kingdom-building adventures are gigantic! Build a world with your friends in A World of Keflings! Harvest resources, construct robots, befriend a dragon, and help a creepy witch get even creepier in this update of the classic 2010 city-building adventure.

item.title: PAYDAY 3: Fear & Greed Tailor Pack
item.description: The Fear & Greed Tailor Pack gives a visual representation of greed itself as heisters don the typical garb of the dreaded day trader.

item.title: Poppy Playtime - Chapter 3
item.description: A decrepit orphanage known as Playcare sits beneath the once magical toy factory. You must make your way through this haunted place, solving new puzzles and avoiding the nightmares that lurk within the dark. Answers lie between the blood-stained bedsheets and screaming echoes... If you can survive.

item.title: Quern - Undying Thoughts
item.description: Discover the truth about Quern’s past, unfold the mysteries of its present, and be the explorer who shapes its future. Quern introduces reusable puzzle mechanics to the classic genre, making the player think about the game as a whole, and not just as a series of individual challenges.

item.title: PITH
item.description: Traverse a wonderful and strange world, find playful tools, and uncover secrets in PITH, a metroidbrainia/puzzle-platforming adventure full of twists and surprises.

item.title: Punch The Walls
item.description: Locked in a cell with nothing but your fists. Punch the walls into cubes, vacuum up the rubble and shred it for cash. Upgrade, dig through harder rock, and find the notes the prisoners before you left behind: they hold the code to the door.

item.title: Cheater's Table
item.description: At this table, cheating is the game. Hide your power cards up your sleeve or down your pant leg, then strike when the time is right. But stay sharp - a scratch isn't always a cheat. This table is full of traps...

item.title: Gear Up Einstein!
item.description: A strategic roguelite auto-battler for 1-3 players. Travel through time, recruit historical figures, and gear them up with badass equipment for ridiculous combos. Master tactical missions solo or with friends. Ready to save the world?

item.title: Tenebrarium
item.description: An idle-like alien colony simulator. Study an alien species and expand the colony to discover all their peculiar behaviours.

item.title: Armello
item.description: Armello is a grim fairy-tale board game come to life, with every match combining deep, tactical card play, rich tabletop strategy and RPG elements. Leverage subterfuge, spells and careful strategy to wrangle control of the game's chaotic odds as you quest for the throne.

item.title: Crosshair X
item.description: Improve your aim and accuracy in every shooter you play. Crosshair X overlays a custom crosshair on top of any game, even games that do not include one. Choose from thousands of community designs or build your own with the designer.

item.title: Find The Needle
item.description: You have a shovel and a haystack with about six million strands in it. Somewhere inside there's a needle. Dig it out by hand, sell the hay, then spend the money on belts and machines until you don't have to dig anymore.

item.title: It's About Pirates
item.description: Command your ship in an action-packed pirate roguelike. Combine deadly weapons, powerful items, and a fearless captain to create unique builds and survive the dangers of the high seas!

item.title: Late Shift
item.description: Late Shift is a high stakes FMV crime thriller. Forced into a brutal London heist, your choices matter in this interactive cinematic experience with adaptable storylines that lead to one of seven conclusions. Your decisions are you.

item.title: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor
item.description: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor is a turn-based party RPG set in the Forgotten Realms. Build a band of heroes, descend into the haunted elven ruins of Myth Drannor, and use tactical positioning, spellcraft and steel to stop a dracolich from corrupting the realm.

item.title: Saloon Simulator
item.description: Start by running a saloon and carve your own place in the Wild West. Shape your bar, hire help, and get drawn into the lives and troubles of the people who gather around your counter. Out here, honest business is rarely enough. See what it takes to survive the frontier.

item.title: Sir Whoopass™: Immortal Death
item.description: WARNING: This game contains puns, dad jokes, flappy-bird-like-arcade-minigames, breaking of the 4th wall and jabs directed at tryhard-overly-serious-RPGS. Do not play if you hate FUN or would not like to strap in for a Hilarious quest for The Legendary Villain-Beating Artifact™.

item.title: TFC2: The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of The Bronze Age
item.description: Lead your small caravan on a great journey across the ancient world, in a story-driven base-building RTS where protecting your family and friends matters more than conquest.

item.title: You Suck at Parking® - Complete Edition
item.description: You Suck at Parking® is the only racing game where your goal is to stop and parking your ride is more important than your driving skills. It’s a hot race against the clock as you drift, cruise, and go airborne over 250 frustratingly fun, wild levels.

item.title: Hunting Simulator 3 - Classic American Hunter Pack
item.description: This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.
